title: Bug 648535: Reprice subcontracting lines after scheduling
summary: Fixed repricing of subcontracting purchase lines in multiple scenarios: carrying out worksheet costs when no price matches, editing dates on released orders, and rescheduling with lead-time adjustments.
key_points: Prevents overwriting calculated worksheet costs with raw routing rates when no matching price exists
Uses standard subcontracting worksheet cost formula as fallback instead of routing rate
Skips financial repricing for non-open purchase orders to avoid validation errors
Keys planned-date repricing on the final Order Date to catch all rescheduling scenarios
Adds comprehensive regression tests covering pricing edge cases and date-edit scenarios
quote: Detects whether the transferred worksheet value is the automatically selected price before repricing it
